# @arki/clock

> A `Clock` you inject instead of calling `Date` and `setTimeout`. `SystemClock` for production, `MockClock` for tests. It is not a scheduler or a date library.

## Import paths

<!-- llms:start -->
- `@arki/clock`: A clock you inject instead of calling `Date` and `setTimeout`: `SystemClock` for production, `MockClock` for tests. `CLOCK_ERROR_CODES`, `ClockError`, `MAX_TIMER_MS`, `MockClock`, `SLEEP_FAILURES`, `SleepCancelled`, `SystemClock`; types `Clock`, `ClockErrorCode`, `SleepFailure`.
<!-- llms:end -->

## Rules that bite

- Take a `Clock` parameter. Never call `new Date()` or `setTimeout` in logic a test must control.
- `advance` is synchronous. Use `advanceAsync` when async code sets the next timer.
- Delays above `MAX_TIMER_MS` (about 24.8 days) throw `ARKI_CLOCK_E002`.
- `setNow` fires no timers.
